about: Labelled claims for tools/factcheck_calibration.py. 'true': clearly true. 'false': clearly false, many of them plausible-sounding falsehoods (one detail swapped, or a popular myth). 'obscure': true but little-known, where 'unverifiable' is a good answer; reported, never part of the pass criterion. Written from well-documented history; a human should re-read it before relying on a verdict.
